data.title: CCTV4: What sustains a millennium-old cultural lineage? Enduring Chinese Academies is coming soon
data.description:
CCTV4: What sustains a millennium-old cultural lineage? Enduring Chinese Academies is coming soon

CCTV4: What sustains a millennium-old cultural lineage? Enduring Chinese Academies is coming soon

PR Newswire

BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026

BEIJING, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The cultural lineage of Huaxia has been passed on like an unbroken thread for thousands of years. Nestled amid mountains and rivers and standing the test of time, ancient academies serve as living carriers of the Chinese pursuit of scholarship, moral self-cultivation and devotion to the country and its people.

Enduring Chinese Academies, a seasonal cultural exploration series produced by the Global Chinese Programming Center of China Media Group (CMG), is set to premiere soon.

The series consists of ten episodes. Guided by its core theme — "One academy, one spirit", it brings together a cross-field lineup of cultural figures to form an Academy Exploration Team. The team will visit ten historic academies in sequence: Bailudong Academy, Yuelu Academy, Songyang Academy, Yingtian Academy, Wenjin Academy (Asking-the-Fording Academy), Donglin Academy, Guanzhong Academy, Kaoting Academy, Longgang Academy and Dongpo Academy.

From investigating things to attain knowledge to the unity of knowledge and action, from applying scholarship to real-world governance to embracing the world as one's mission, the show traces the roots of this cultural heritage and seeks wisdom in the classics. It presents the charm of ancient academies, the integrity of noble scholars, and the enduring cultural lineage of China.

The program features a special AI film segment, A Moment Across a Millennium. Through digital imagery, it recounts the stories and philosophies of celebrated ancient scholars including Zhu Xi, Zhang Shi, Fan Zhongyan, Wang Yangming and Su Shi, interpreting the profound, timeless wisdom of Chinese academies for global audiences.

Starting November 22, Enduring Chinese Academies airs on CCTV-4 (China Media Group's Chinese International Channel) at 21:30 every Sunday. We sincerely invite audiences worldwide to join this journey through a thousand years of cultural heritage.

data.title: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Appoints Carolyn Kissane as Independent Director, Joining Jason E. Dodier and other Board Members to Bring Critical Expertise to Advance Physical AI Education, Industry Partnerships and Scalable Commercialization
data.description:
FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Appoints Carolyn Kissane as Independent Director, Joining Jason E. Dodier and other Board Members to Bring Critical Expertise to Advance Physical AI Education, Industry Partnerships and Scalable Commercialization

FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem (FFR) Appoints Carolyn Kissane as Independent Director, Joining Jason E. Dodier and other Board Members to Bring Critical Expertise to Advance Physical AI Education, Industry Partnerships and Scalable Commercialization

PR Newswire

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 19, 2026
  • Carolyn Kissane, Associate Dean of NYU's Center for Global Affairs, brings expertise in higher education and academic-industry collaboration to help advance FFR's robotics education ecosystem, talent development, and developer engagement.
  • Independent Director Jason E. Dodier brings critical expertise in commercial development, capital formation, infrastructure, and operations to support industry partnerships and scalable commercialization, reinforcing FFR's positioning as the first U.S.-listed pure-play "Four-Core Full-Stack AI" humanoid and bionic EAI robotics ecosystem company.

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR) ("FFR" or the "Company"), a U.S.-based Embodied AI robotics company, today announced that Carolyn Kissane, Associate Dean of New York University's Center for Global Affairs, has been appointed as Independent Director, joining Independent Director Jason E. Dodier as the two most recently appointed members among the Company's independent directors.

As Associate Dean of NYU's Center for Global Affairs, Ms. Kissane oversees a portfolio spanning graduate education, continuing education, public programming, and philanthropic programs.

Ms. Kissane has helped develop academic offerings and external partnerships across areas including technology, energy, sustainability, and business. She is also the founding director of the Global Energy, Climate, and Sustainability Lab, a platform connecting research, industry engagement, and applied learning. Her experience is expected to provide valuable perspectives as FFR continues to develop its robotics education ecosystem and explore opportunities for Physical AI and robotics in learning, applied research, and talent development.

In addition, Ms. Kissane serves on the boards of the New York Energy Forum and CIV-Lab and as an industry advisor to Ridgewood Infrastructure.

Mr. Dodier has served on FFR's Board as an Independent Director since August 2026. He brings more than 15 years of experience in commercial development, capital formation, infrastructure, and operations. Previously, Mr. Dodier co-founded and served as Chief Commercial Officer of Grain Ecosystem, where he helped build the company's commercial function from its inception through its acquisition. He also held commercial leadership roles at Schneider Electric and served as Vice President of Development at AlphaStruxure, a joint venture between The Carlyle Group and Schneider Electric.

Ms. Kissane's academic and industry engagement experience and Mr. Dodier's commercial and infrastructure background bring complementary perspectives to FFR's Board as the Company advances its "Four-Core Full-Stack AI" robotics ecosystem. Their combined expertise is expected to strengthen the Board's strategic guidance on connecting education and research with developer engagement, industry partnerships, and real-world robotics applications. For FFR, these connections are central to building an ecosystem in which talent development and applied research support technology innovation, while industry collaboration creates pathways toward commercialization and broader deployment.

"We are pleased to welcome Carolyn to FFR's Board," said YT Jia, CEO of FFR. "Building a leading Physical AI robotics ecosystem requires us to connect technology, talent, industry, and capital. Carolyn's experience in higher education and connecting research with industry will bring a valuable perspective as we continue to develop our robotics education ecosystem. Together with Carolyn, Jason's background in commercial development, capital markets, and operations will also provide valuable insight as FFR advances its robotics business. Their perspectives will help guide FFR as we advance our strategy and work toward turning robotics capabilities into real-world productivity and long-term shareholder value."

About FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc.

FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. (NASDAQ: FFR) is a U.S.-based Embodied AI robotics company focused on the research and development, manufacturing, commercialization and deployment of intelligent robotic technologies, products and industry solutions. FFR is building a "Four-Core Full-Stack" AI ecosystem covering the full lifecycle of robotics, consisting of Physical AI Brain & Developer Platform, Physical AI Devices, Physical AI Industry Productivity Solutions, and Physical AI Data Factory. Guided by the technology and product philosophy of "One Brain, Multi-forms, Multi-capabilities," FFR aims to empower humanoid, biomimetic, and other robotic form factors through a unified Physical AI Brain, while continuously expanding their multi-task and multi-scenario capabilities. The ecosystem is designed to support the full robotics lifecycle, including R&D, deployment, data collection and training, operations, and commercial applications. FFR also operates RoboShare, a robot-sharing and services platform. To learn more, visit www.ff.com.

data.title: AV Access Unveils iDock B12 8K KVM Docking Station for High-Refresh Gaming and Dual-Computer Workstations
data.description:
AV Access Unveils iDock B12 8K KVM Docking Station for High-Refresh Gaming and Dual-Computer Workstations

AV Access Unveils iDock B12 8K KVM Docking Station for High-Refresh Gaming and Dual-Computer Workstations

PR Newswire

SPOKANE, Wash., Nov. 19, 2026

The iDock B12 delivers smooth 4K@165Hz gaming with VRR, 2.5GbE networking, and 11-in-1 connectivity for dual-PC setups.

SPOKANE, Wash., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AV Access, a leading provider of Pro AV and AV over IP solutions, has introduced the iDock B12, an 8K dual-monitor KVM docking station designed to make switching between work and gaming setups effortless. With refresh rates of up to 4K@165Hz or 1080p@480Hz and 2.5GbE networking, the iDock B12 delivers smooth visuals and fast connectivity in one compact solution for gamers, creators, and hybrid professionals.

AV Access introduces iDock B12, an 8K KVM dock with 4K@165Hz gaming, 2.5GbE networking, and one-touch PC switching.

High-Refresh Gaming with 2.5GbE Networking

Built for high-performance gaming and demanding visual workflows, the iDock B12 supports resolutions and refresh rates up to 8K@60Hz, 4K@165Hz, or 1080p@480Hz/360Hz on compatible desktop PCs. It also supports Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), including NVIDIA G-SYNC and AMD FreeSync, helping reduce screen tearing and deliver smoother, more responsive gameplay.

Beyond display performance, the iDock B12 brings faster networking and data transfer to the desktop. Its 2.5GbE Ethernet connection provides high-speed wired networking for large file transfers, NAS access, game downloads, and other bandwidth-intensive tasks.

"Managing a work laptop and a gaming PC on one desk often means dealing with cable clutter or compromising on display performance," said Bill Liao, CTO at AV Access. "The iDock B12 brings laptop docking and KVM switching together in one solution, maintaining high refresh rates and fast network connectivity. It makes switching between work and play simpler than ever."

One Dock. Two Computers. One Shared Workspace.

Designed for users who work and play across two computers, the iDock B12 simplifies how both systems share a single desk setup. A laptop connects through a single USB-C cable for dual 4K video output, data transfer, network access, and up to 100W power delivery, while a desktop PC connects via separate video and USB cables. Both computers can share the same monitors, keyboard, mouse, and other peripherals, keeping the entire setup connected and ready for either system.

The iDock B12 brings 11-in-1 connectivity to everyday work and gaming setups, supporting everything from high-speed external storage and peripherals to SD cards and audio devices. With 10Gbps USB 3.2 ports, it brings essential connections together in one compact hub, helping users maintain a clean and organized workspace.

Pricing and Availability

The iDock B12 is available now on the official AV Access website for $299.99. As part of AV Access's Black Friday and Cyber Monday sale, customers can save 15% from November 19–30, bringing the price down to $254.99. For more information, visit:https://www.avaccess.com/products/idock-b12/

About AV Access

AV Access is a professional AV manufacturer offering AV over IP solutions, meeting devices, KVM docking stations, HDMI, USB, and KVM extenders, and more. Our products serve meeting rooms, sports bars, AI workstations, gaming setups, home offices, and classrooms, delivering reliable performance, practical innovation, competitive pricing, and dependable support.

Website: https://www.avaccess.com/

data.title: GOOGL CLASS ACTION NOTICE: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP Expands Class Period in the Securities Fraud Lawsuit On Behalf Of Alphabet Inc. (GOOG; GOOGL) Investors
data.description:
GOOGL CLASS ACTION NOTICE: Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP Expands Class Period in the Securities Fraud Lawsuit On Behalf Of Alphabet Inc. (GOOG; GOOGL) Investors

Lawsuit asserts claims on behalf of investors who acquired Alphabet Inc. securities between May 19, 2026 and October 28, 2026; lead plaintiff motions are due December 1, 2026.

Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP ("Glancy") announces that it has filed an amended class action complaint, expanding the class period, in the action captioned Stewart v. Alphabet Inc. et al., (Case No. 5:26-cv-11290-PCP) pending in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California. The action is now on behalf of persons and entities that purchased or otherwise acquired Alphabet Inc. ("Alphabet" or the "Company") (NASDAQ: GOOG; GOOGL) securities between May 19, 2026 and October 28, 2026, inclusive (the "Class Period"). Plaintiff pursues claims under Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the "Exchange Act").

Investors are hereby notified that they have until December 1, 2026 to move the Court to serve as lead plaintiff in this action.

If you suffered a loss on your Alphabet Inc. investments, inquire about the Alphabet Inc. class action to learn about potentially pursuing claims to recover your loss under the federal securities laws.

Key details of the Alphabet Inc. case

  • Court: United States District Court, Northern District of California
  • Case No.: 5:26-cv-11290-PCP
  • Class period: May 19, 2026 to October 28, 2026, inclusive
  • Claims: Sections 10(b) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act
  • Lead plaintiff motions due: December 1, 2026

What happened?

On July 16, 2026, Bloomberg reported that Google was “months behind schedule on delivering Gemini 3.5 Pro,” its most powerful flagship AI model, due to ongoing development efforts. The report further stated that Google had recently updated the data used to train Gemini in an effort to improve its capabilities, “but the results were disappointing.”

On this news, Alphabet’s Class A common stock price fell $16.46 per share, or 4.4%, to close at $354.46 per share on July 16, 2026. Alphabet’s Class C common stock price fell $16.39 per share, or 4.4%, to close at $353.58 per share on July 16, 2026, thereby injuring investors.

Then, on October 28, 2026, Alphabet reported third quarter 2026 results, including net income of $26.17 billion, down from $34.98 billion in the prior-year period. The Company also reported Google Search & other revenue of $63.35 billion, below analyst expectations of $64.96 billion, and total revenue of $127.58 billion, below analyst expectations of $128.22 billion. During the accompanying earnings call, management disclosed that Search revenue was impacted in part by the integration of Gemini and lower monetization of AI-powered searches, stating that “the strong growth in AI Mode queries had an impact because of the lower monetization we were seeing in AI Mode.”

On this news, Alphabet’s Class A common stock price fell $41.07 per share, or 12.6%, to close at $283.82 per share on October 29, 2026. Alphabet’s Class C common stock price fell $39.57 per share, or 12.3%, to close at $282.32 per share on October 29, 2026, thereby further injuring investors.

What is the Alphabet Inc. lawsuit about?

The complaint filed in this class action alleges that throughout the Class Period, Defendants made materially false and/or misleading statements, as well as failed to disclose material adverse facts about the Company's business, operations, and prospects. Specifically, Defendants failed to disclose to investors that: (1) that Gemini 3.5 Pro was delivering disappointing training results; (2) that, as a result, the launch of Gemini 3.5 Pro would be significantly delayed; (3) that growth in AI Mode queries was negatively impacting Search revenue because AI Mode had lower monetization; (4) that, as a result, Defendants' positive statements about the Company's business, operations, and prospects were materially misleading and/or lacked a reasonable basis at all relevant times.

If you purchased or otherwise acquired Alphabet Inc. securities during the Class Period, you may move the Court no later than December 1, 2026 to ask the Court to appoint you as lead plaintiff.

Contact us to participate or learn more

If you wish to learn more about this action, or if you have any questions concerning this announcement or your rights or interests with respect to these matters, please contact Glancy about the Alphabet Inc. lawsuit, email shareholders@glancylaw.com, or call 310-201-9150 (toll-free: 888-773-9224).

If you inquire by email, please include your mailing address, telephone number, and number of shares purchased.

To be a member of the Class you need not take any action at this time; you may retain counsel of your choice or take no action and remain an absent member of the Class. No class has been certified yet in the Alphabet Inc. case.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is eligible? Persons and entities that purchased or otherwise acquired Alphabet Inc. securities between May 19, 2026 and October 28, 2026 and suffered losses may be members of the proposed class in the Alphabet Inc. securities lawsuit.

What is the Alphabet Inc. lead plaintiff deadline? Motions to serve as lead plaintiff in the Alphabet Inc. class action must be filed by December 1, 2026.

What is a lead plaintiff? In the Alphabet Inc. class action, the lead plaintiff is the investor, or group of investors, that the court appoints to represent all class members and oversee the case. Under the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act, courts generally presume the movant with the largest financial interest is the most adequate lead plaintiff.

Does it cost anything to contact Glancy or participate in this action? Glancy represents Alphabet Inc. investors on a contingency fee basis, so investors pay no attorneys' fees out of pocket. Any attorneys' fees and litigation expenses are paid only from a recovery, if one is obtained, and are subject to court approval.

Why work with Glancy on the Alphabet Inc. lawsuit? Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP is a premier law firm with decades of experience representing investors and consumers in securities litigation and other complex class action litigation. Contact Glancy about the Alphabet Inc. class action. Prior results do not guarantee a similar outcome.

About Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP

Glancy was named one of Law360's Securities Groups of the Year and ranked second in total investor recoveries by ISS Securities Class Action Services in 2025.

Glancy's successes have been widely covered by leading news and industry publications, including The Wall Street Journal, The Financial Times, Bloomberg Businessweek, Reuters, the Associated Press, Barron's, Investor's Business Daily, Forbes, and Money.

data.title: Dow Jones Top Markets Headlines at 9 PM ET: U.S. Stocks Slide as AI Bust Continues Despite Anthropic IPO | Japan ...
data.description:
U.S. Stocks Slide as AI Bust Continues Despite Anthropic IPO

U.S. stocks ended lower in a volatile session as Anthropic's record-breaking initial public offering failed to staunch the bleeding in artificial-intelligence stocks.

----

Japan Consumer Inflation Accelerates Amid Rate-Hike Views

Consumer prices excluding fresh food climbed 2.2% from a year earlier, following September's 2.1% gain, reinforcing expectations for another interest-rate increase by the central bank.

----

Markets are sending troubling signals about the state of the economy

A number of recession trades have started to emerge, even as economic data has largely held up.

----

Fed's Goolsbee Won't Rule Out Larger Rate Increases as Inflation Risks Mount

Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said he does not see evidence that inflation is on the path back to the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

----

Anthropic's IPO Is a Win for Venture. Its Success Could Reshape the Industry.

The Claude chatbot maker's backers invested capital at an unprecedented scale into the artificial-intelligence giant in a departure from venture's usual playbook.

----

U.S. Diesel Prices to Continue to Fall in Relief for Consumers, U.S. Energy Secretary Says

Diesel prices are likely to continue falling from record highs as refined products from the Persian Gulf return to the market and unsanctioned Russian diesel adds to the downward pressure on prices, said Energy Secretary Chris Wright.

----

Canada's Banking Regulator Moves to Level Playing Field for Smaller Lenders

Canada's financial-industry watchdog plans to soften capital requirements for smaller lenders in a bid to boost competition and break the hold of the handful of major banks on the industry.

----

Fed Cuts Pay Raises for Regional-Bank Staff

Employees at the 12 regional banks were told to expect 1% annual raises, down from 3% this year.

----

U.S. Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Move Higher

U.S. jobless claims unexpectedly pushed higher last week, and the number of people seeking ongoing weekly benefits surged the week prior.

----

Canada Producer Prices Rise Again in October, Buoyed by Energy Products

Statistics Canada's industrial product price index increased 0.3% in October from the month before, a softer advance than the downwardly revised 1.5% increase in September.

----

South African Reserve Bank Maintains Main Repo Rate at 7.25%

SARB Governor Lesetja Kganyago said South Africa's inflation has been much higher than expected and fixed investment is too low.

data.title: Boston Scientific announces pricing of $3.0 billion and €4.25 billion offerings of senior notes
data.description:
Boston Scientific announces pricing of $3.0 billion and €4.25 billion offerings of senior notes

Boston Scientific announces pricing of $3.0 billion and €4.25 billion offerings of senior notes

PR Newswire

MARLBOROUGH, Mass., Nov. 19, 2026

MARLBOROUGH, Mass., Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Boston Scientific Corporation (the "Company") (NYSE: BSX) announced today that it has priced a public offering of $3,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of U.S. dollar-denominated notes (the "USD Offering"), consisting of $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.375% Senior Notes due 2029, $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.500% Senior Notes due 2031, $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.750% Senior Notes due 2033 and $500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.875% Senior Notes due 2036 (collectively, the "USD Notes").

In addition, the Company announced today that American Medical Systems Europe B.V., its indirect wholly owned finance subsidiary, has priced a public offering of €4,250,000,000 aggregate principal amount of euro-denominated notes (the "Euro Offering" and, together with the USD Offering, the "Offerings"), consisting of €500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due 2028 (the "Floating Rate Notes"), €500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.875% Senior Notes due 2028, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.125% Senior Notes due 2030, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.500% Senior Notes due 2034, €1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.750% Senior Notes due 2038 and €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.125% Senior Notes due 2046 (collectively with the Floating Rate Notes, the "Euro Notes"). The Euro Notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed by the Company.

The Offerings are being made pursuant to a registration statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Offerings are expected to close on December 1, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Neither Offering is conditioned upon the completion of the other Offering. The Company intends to use the net proceeds from the Offerings, together with short-term borrowings and/or borrowings under its credit agreement(s) and cash on hand, to finance the cash consideration payable in connection with the acquisition of Penumbra, Inc. (the "Penumbra Acquisition") and to pay related fees and expenses and, to the extent that the net proceeds from the Offerings are not used for such purposes, for general corporate purposes, which may include, among other things, short term investments, reduction of short term debt, funding of working capital and potential future acquisitions.

The Offerings are not conditioned upon the completion of the Penumbra Acquisition. However, if the Penumbra Acquisition is not completed on or before the applicable special mandatory redemption end date, or if the applicable issuer notifies the trustee that the Company will not pursue completion of the Penumbra Acquisition, each series of the USD Notes and the Euro Notes, except for the Floating Rate Notes, will be subject to a special mandatory redemption at a redemption price equal to 101% of the aggregate principal amount of such series, plus accrued and unpaid interest, if any, to, but excluding, the special mandatory redemption date.

Nothing herein shall constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy the securities, nor shall there be any sale of the securities in any state or jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful prior to qualification under the securities laws of any such state or jurisdiction. The Offerings are being made by means of a prospectus and related separate preliminary prospectus supplements only. Copies of the prospectus and related preliminary prospectus supplement for the USD Notes, and information concerning the USD Offering, may be obtained by contacting the joint book-running managers for the USD Offering: BofA Securities, Inc., toll-free at 1-800-294-1322; Citigroup Global Markets Inc., toll-free at 1-800-831-9146; or J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, collect at 1-212-834-4533. Copies of the prospectus and related preliminary prospectus supplement for the Euro Notes, and information concerning the Euro Offering, may be obtained by contacting the joint book-running managers for the Euro Offering: Barclays Bank PLC, toll-free at 1-888-603-5847; Citigroup Global Markets Europe AG, toll-free at 1-800-831-9146; or J.P. Morgan SE, collect at +49 69 71240 (for non-U.S. investors) or J.P. Morgan Securities LLC collect at 1-212-834-4533 (for U.S. investors).

About Boston Scientific

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions.
